name: Cheesy Smashed Potatoes with Bacon, Mushrooms, Tomato & Green Onion

instructions.primary_message: Wash potatoes; transfer to a large pot, add salt, cover with hot water (from the tap), and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to medium and cook until potatoes can be easily pierced with a fork, about 15 minutes.
Preheat a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat.
Add bacon to the skillet and cook until crispy, 3-5 minutes per side. Cook in batches if necessary.
Wash and dry the remaining fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
0.68 kg white mushrooms
1 small bunch green onions (scallions)
3 tomatoes

instructions.primary_message: When the bacon is done, remove and set aside on a paper towel-lined plate. Transfer the bacon fat to a small bowl and set aside, leaving about 1 tbsp in the skillet.
Return skillet to medium heat. Add mushrooms and season with salt and pepper. Cook, stirring often, until tender, 4-5 minutes; remove from heat and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
¼ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Crumble or chop bacon into small pieces.

When the potatoes are done, drain and divide between 2 large baking sheet pans. Using a fork or potato masher, gently crush each potato, flattening them to a 1-inch thickness. Drizzle with ¼ cup reserved bacon fat and season with salt and pepper; toss to coat.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Sprinkle cheese, mushrooms, and bacon over the potatoes. Place in the oven and bake until cheese is melted, 3-5 minutes.
Meanwhile, trim off and discard ends of green onions, then cut crosswise into ¼-inch pieces at an angle. Small dice tomatoes.
To serve, divide smashed potatoes between plates or bowls. Top with green onion, tomato, and yogurt. Enjoy!
